thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT 1735554321 - cont-batch latency spike on prod-gpu-pool. 90th p99 token latency > 2.5s, error rate up from 0.1% -> 4.2%. Auto-escalating to #eng-oncall. link: https://internal.monitoring/r/alert/1735554321
maya: grabbing it, pinging devon. any customer-facing errors yet?
devon: seeing queue depth climb fast on cb-workers-17..21, microbatch sizes spiking to 64 intermittently. KV cache evictions are high (evict/sec ~ 1.8k). suspect prefetch/backfill loop. logs: ```kvcache: evicting key=usr:kv:abc status=throttled reason=memory_pressure```
maya: ok reduce prefetch aggressiveness, set PREFETCH_WINDOW=20 -> 6 on those nodes. i'll try a hotpatch to config.
oliver: tagging customer-impact. a handful of requests returned 502/timeout around 02:12-02:18 UTC, total ~1.3k user requests, mostly low-latency apps. CS already flagged a spike.
devon: trying to repro locally with a load generator, observing microbatch jitter when concurrent sessions >120 per worker. looks like continuous-batch scheduler's batching window mis-estimates arrival rates under high concurrency.
maya: running quick mitigation: deploy config change to autoscaler and prefetch throttle. command: ```kubectl patch cm cb-config -n infra --patch '{"data":{"PREFETCH_WINDOW":"6","MAX_MICROBATCH":16}}'```
infra-bot: configmap patched cb-config in namespace infra (cb-config@sha256:9f3e). Rolling restart scheduled for cb-worker-{17..21}.
devon: rolling restart started. restarting workers one-by-one to avoid KV cache melt. logs show drop in evictions after restart on worker-19.
sam: i'm on night shift, taking handoff if you need me to stay on it. what's the status on rollout?
maya: thanks Sam. restart in progress, 4/5 workers restarted. p99 latency trending down from 2.6s -> 1.1s but there are still transient spikes.
deploy-bot: started rollout hotpatch/1735554321-prefetch-throttle to cb-worker pool (canary=1, max_surge=1).
devon: added additional telemetry: emit microbatch_size histogram and queue_sleep_ms. early data shows microbatch_size mode moved 32 -> 12 after config change. queue_sleep_ms median down from 180ms -> 40ms.
oliver: customer impact: updating CS status page: "We experienced elevated latencies and transient errors for the embeddings endpoint between 02:12-02:20 UTC. We believe mitigation is applied; remediation is ongoing."
sre-lead: good mitigation. we need a postmortem checklist: root cause hypothesis = prefetch+continuous-batch feedback loop under high concurrency causing KV cache churn and larger microbatches -> perf cliff. Also note lack of guardrails in scheduler to cap microbatch growth when KV eviction rate crosses threshold.
maya: agree. immediate follow-ups: 1) enforce MAX_MICROBATCH=16 globally, 2) add eviction_rate_based_prefetch_backoff, 3) add circuit to fallback to fixed microbatching when queueing > X.
devon: i'm going to commit a small change that gates prefetch rate by eviction/sec and roll a canary tomorrow morning. patch: ```if evict_rate > 1000: prefetch_rate *= 0.2```
sam: taking ongoing pager. i'll monitor dashboards and want a clear runbook note for mid-night ops. tagging oncall-rotation for handoff.
maya: leaving the channel in 10m. Sam will be primary. Sam can escalate to devon/oliver if it regresses.
sam: ack, will keep an eye. also will run a synthetic traffic spike test in 30m to validate.
infra-bot: synthetic test scheduled: loadgen scenario "cb-concurrency-spike" -> started at 02:52 UTC.
devon: synthetic looks stable at current configs. microbatch jitter reduced, no evict spikes during test.
maya: thanks team. logging this for postmortem. created ticket INFRA-8241 to track follow-ups and remediation work.
oliver: asked product to notify the top 10 affected customers; they want a succinct timeline + root cause once postmortem is done.
sam: handoff complete. will update if anything changes. :thumbsup:
